notes_review: The logged calls are sound: Marx defines the compositions of capital himself, so §7 is rightly left out there; "means of payment" and "metamorphosed" are rightly treated as non-technical uses; and the ambiguous absolute/proportional clauses in p014 are kept open. Stacking six §7 explanations after Marx's definition in p002 is heavy, but it follows the rules.
summary: Fidelity is very good: the long causal chain in p005, the alternative in p014, and the Mandeville, Eden and n. 6 quotations are kept accurately, with one small added hedge. Readability is good, although p002 and p014 carry many first-use explanations.
